name: رابطه سمی و نشانه‌هایش
description: A Persian user asks about toxic relationship signs, how to leave, then shares that their spouse is controlling. Verifies the relationship_toxic fact answers in Persian with warning signs and safety-first advice, and the disclosure gets an empathetic reply.

turns.text: چطور از رابطه سمی خارج شوم؟
فکر میکنم همسرم داره کنترل میکنه

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: the red-flags question returns the relationship_toxic fact. Turn 2: the leaving question returns the same safety-first guidance. Turn 3: the controlling-spouse disclosure routes to the relationship/feeling rules.
expected.behavior: Toxic-relationship guidance in Persian names control, isolation, put-downs, gaslighting, and aggression, prioritizes safety, and frames leaving as a supported process.
